# A `__dirname`-relative path breaks when operator-core is bundled

## The trap

operator-core source lives at `packages/operator-core/lib/<area>/…` — **4 levels**
below the repo root. Code often reaches a repo-relative asset (a migration tree,
a fixture) with a fixed climb:

```ts
const __dirname = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const SQL_DIR = join(__dirname, '../../../../libs/papercusp/libs/db/sql');
```

That is correct **only when the module runs from source**. The live operator runs
from the **bundled** build `apps/operator/dist-host/hono-host.mjs`, where esbuild
sets `import.meta.url` (and thus `__dirname`) to `apps/operator/dist-host` —
**3 levels** below the repo root, one shallower than the source. Up-four then
overshoots to `<workspace>/libs/…` (the workspace *parent* of the repo), which
does not exist.

## The symptom it produced (EI-8689)

`gym-db-init.ts` resolved its migration dir this way. Under the bundle, every
`gym-cycle` autoloop fire died with:

```
ENOENT: no such file or directory, scandir
'/home/…/papercupai-workspace/libs/papercusp/libs/db/sql'
```

Note the missing `papercusp/` segment — that is the tell of an up-one-too-many
climb. The gym ran chronically red (14 consecutive fires) because the fire-gate
backoff throttled it but nothing surfaced it as dead capability.

## Why it's easy to miss

Every on-disk `.ts` copy resolves to an **existing** dir (source depth is right),
so grep/local checks look fine. Only the *bundled* `dist-host/*.mjs` — where
`import.meta.url` is shallower — produces the bad path. Confirm which one the live
operator runs from before trusting a source-relative resolution.

## The fix: walk up to a marker, don't count levels

Resolve by climbing from the module location to the first ancestor that actually
**contains** the target, so it works at any depth (source or bundle):

```ts
function resolveMainSqlDir(startDir: string): string {
  let dir = resolve(startDir);
  for (let i = 0; i < 16; i += 1) {
    const candidate = join(dir, 'libs/papercusp/libs/db/sql');
    if (existsSync(candidate)) return candidate;
    const parent = dirname(dir);
    if (parent === dir) break;
    dir = parent;
  }
  return join(startDir, '../../../..', 'libs/papercusp/libs/db/sql'); // deterministic fallback
}
```

The same shape already exists in `agent-tools/docs/_repo-paths.ts`
(`findRepoRoot`) — reuse a walk-up resolver rather than counting `../`.

**Rule of thumb:** any `join(__dirname, '../../..')` in operator-core that reaches
a repo-root asset is a latent bundle bug. Walk up to a real marker instead of
hardcoding the climb, and regression-test that source-depth and a simulated
`apps/operator/dist-host` depth resolve to the *identical* real path.
